title: 第79章 我唐逸，大炎军校校长！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: “狄老，训练手册等下准备笔墨，我训练完写给你。”唐逸也没有拒绝，沉吟了一下道：“但我觉得，在让他们正式上训练场之前，得先整顿一下军纪。”“最好，还是从基础训练抓起。”狄苍眼微眯，道：“基础训练？哪些基础训练？”唐逸淡淡道：“左转，右转，踏步，齐步，正步……这些东西是基础，说句实话，大炎现在军队没有凝聚力，一部分原因就是基础没抓好。”“一部分原因，是军功晋级有问题，当然，还有一部分原因，文官压得太厉害。”那些文官想要大炎将士保护他们的财产，又不想让他们有太高的战斗力和权势威胁到他们的地位，典型的想要马儿跑，却又不给马儿草！狄苍和秦牧三人相视一眼，哟呵，这小子倒是看得挺通透。除了所谓的基础训练他们不太懂，不过听这小子说感觉很厉害啊！至于另外两个原因，说得倒是很透彻。要不然，他们也不会被文官怼成孙子而无可奈何。“既然如此，为了验证你的说法，那他们就交给你训练了。”狄苍沉吟了一下，就算拿到训练手册，那也是个死物。没有人会，肯定玩不转。既然唐逸知道怎么玩，那索性就让他带着玩呗。他目光灼灼地看向唐逸，道：“毕竟这些东西，现在知道的只有你……嗯，我会请示陛下，将驻守京都的所有将领都调过来。”“以后，他们都归你训练。”练兵，先得练将！秦牧一拍脑袋，道：“包括老夫，都给你训！”程茂手将胸膛拍得跟鼓一样响，道：“小子，算上我，别看老夫老了，上阵杀敌老夫依旧是万夫之勇。”唐逸瞬间向后跳了两步，心有震撼，靠，怎么感觉狄苍老头要害我？让我训练满京都的将领，京畿十八卫禁军，大大小小将领四五百人，都是骄兵悍将，个个武艺高强，随便出来一个都能打我一顿你信吗？！但是，虽然危机重重，却又是个极佳的机会。这相当于是他一个小小的锦衣卫百户，一跃成了大炎军校的校长。到时候出去吹牛逼的时候，就能大喘气：我，唐逸，大炎军校的校长，连统率千军万马的大帅，都是我的学生。那画面，想想都带感！唐逸沉吟了一下，道：“可以，我可以试试。”狄苍闻言，脸上立即绽放开菊花般的笑容。原本以为唐逸会害怕，会拒绝，他会浪费一番口舌劝说。却没想到他竟然答应得这么痛快，当即拍着他的肩膀大笑道：“好，是个好男儿，那现在就把你的训练方案弄出来，老夫晚点就进宫见陛下。”“北狄猖狂，东虞又虎视眈眈，我们能堪大用的将领还是太少了。”唐逸知道狄苍办事素来雷厉风行，今日的训练量只能暂时搁置了，让三个老头等他训练完，估计得挨打。他只能取过纸笔，将训练方式方法方针一一写出来，直到天黑才将《步兵训练手册》写完，交给了狄苍。狄苍拿到手册，立即带着秦牧和程茂，马不停蹄进宫了。而唐逸，只能打着哈欠回府。……唐家。唐逸回到唐家的时候，已经是晚上。刚进门，唐逸便听到耳边传来阵阵笑声。声音很熟悉。唐逸淡淡看了一眼，便不由冷笑一声。不远处，唐敬一家正坐在院中乘凉。唐画抱着书卷躺在吊床上悠闲在看，儒雅而慵懒。唐浩和林竹虽然带着伤，却在亲密喂食。而唐敬则坐在桌前，正和一个蓄着山羊须的中年男人对弈。颜霜玉站在唐敬身后，而给山羊须男人出谋划策的，是个穿着青色长裙的女人。女孩十七八岁，很漂亮，笑容干净甜美，看上去清纯动人。男人正是御史台御史姜正，而女孩是姜正的女儿，姜家大小姐，姜云娜。画面倒是挺温馨，可惜处处充斥着阴谋的臭味。唐逸理都没理，转身离开。这时，姜云娜也发现了他。她看着唐逸眼底情绪有些复杂，当年明明是个儒雅温和的少年郎，为什么现在变成了个心肠歹毒的人呢？真让人失望。亏得唐画哥哥这么温柔潇洒风采风流的人，还一直给他说好话呢，一点都不值得。想到和唐画的约定，姜云娜眼底的情绪迅速敛去，俏脸上泛起一抹晕红。唐画哥哥答应她了，只要她能够稳住唐逸，不要让唐逸在陛下赐婚这件事上捣乱，将来就娶她为平妻。不是妾，是和孔诗岚平起平坐的平妻！而且唐画哥哥说了爱的是她，和孔诗岚不过是逢场做戏，将来唐家的主母还是她。“逸哥哥，你回来了？”想到这些，姜云娜笑着向唐逸跑过去，想要抓住唐逸的手。拿捏唐逸而已，对她来说轻轻松松。以前只要她招招手，唐逸就像条狗一样跑过来。现在，他会错过这种机会？唐画放下书，单手枕着头，戏谑看了过来。哼，你不是能言善辩吗？辛苦给你搭好了戏台，你可要好好地演啊！唐浩和林竹也都放下水果，冷笑盯着唐逸。他们可都知道，唐逸对姜云娜有着不一般的感情。这些年，无论他们怎么欺凌，唐逸都逆来顺受。唯一一次动手打了唐画，还是唐画故意设计说要娶姜云娜，才彻底激怒他动的手。而动手的后果就是，被唐画忽悠瘸了的姜云娜对唐逸更加的失望了！嘿嘿，现在给了这家伙机会，姜云娜招招手，估计这家伙就会像一条狗一般乖巧跑到姜云娜的面前。就连颜霜玉，此时眼中也满是嘲弄之色。然而，就在他们以为唐逸会激动到发狂的时候。唐逸却下意识向后退了一步，没让姜云娜的手碰到他。“姜小姐，请自重。”语气淡漠而疏远，拒人千里之外。唐逸看着姜云娜僵在半空的手，看到颜霜玉唐画等人错愕的表情，只觉得可笑。前身以前是舔狗，和我有什么关系？想要我也当舔狗？怕不是想太多了。真想舔，当晚在幻音坊我就不会跑了，准能舔个够，咳咳……不能受梁绍那混账的影响，老子是正经人！暗暗吐槽了一下，就看到姜云娜眼睛一眨，双眸微微殷红，声音凄凄：“逸哥哥，我是娜娜啊，你不要我了吗？”
content_en: "Mr. Di, I'll prepare the pen and ink for the training manual later. I'll write it to you after the training." Tang Yi did not refuse, and said after a while: "But I think that before letting them officially go to the training ground, military discipline must be rectified first." "It's best to start with basic training." Di Cang narrowed his eyes and said, "Basic training? What basic training?" Tang Yi said lightly: "Turn left, turn right, step, step, goose... these thingswest is the foundation. To be honest, Dayan's current army has no cohesion, and part of the reason is that the foundation has not been grasped well."Part of the reason is that there is a problem with military promotion, and of course, part of the reason is that the civilian officials are too heavy-handed."Those civilian officials want Dayan soldiers to protect their property, but they don't want them to have too high combat effectiveness and power to threaten their status. They typically want the horse to run away, but they don't give the horse any grass.Di Cang and Qin Mu looked at each other and said, "Oh, this guy is quite perceptive."They don't know much about it other than the so-called basic training, but hearing this guy say it feels great!As for the other two reasons, they are quite clear.Otherwise, they would not have been treated like grandsons by civil servants and would have been helpless."In that case, in order to verify your statement, they will leave it to you for training." Di Cang pondered for a moment, even if he got the training manual, it would be a dead thing.No one knows how to do it, and they definitely can’t play it.Since Tang Yi knows how to play, just let him play with it.He looked at Tang Yi with burning eyes and said: "After all, you are the only one who knows about these things now... Well, I will ask your Majesty to transfer all the generals stationed in Kyoto." "From now on, they will all be trained by you." To train troops, you must first train generals!Qin Mu slapped his head and said: "Including me, I will teach you!" Cheng Mao beat his chest as loud as a drum and said: "Boy, count me in. Even though I am old, I am still brave enough to kill the enemy in battle." Tang Yi instantly jumped two steps back, his heart was shocked, damn, why do you feel that old man Di Cang wants to hurt me?Let me train all the generals in Kyoto, the Imperial Guards of the Eighteen Guards, four to five hundred generals, big and small. They are all proud and powerful generals. They are all highly skilled in martial arts. Do you believe that anyone who comes out can beat me up?!However, although there are many crises, it is also an excellent opportunity.This is equivalent to him becoming the principal of Dayan Military Academy from a small family of royal guards.When the time comes to brag, you can breathe a sigh of relief: I, Tang Yi, the principal of Dayan Military Academy, and even the commander-in-chief of thousands of troops, are all my students.That picture makes me feel emotional just thinking about it!Tang Yi pondered for a moment and said, "Okay, I can try." When Di Cang heard this, a chrysanthemum-like smile immediately bloomed on his face.I originally thought that Tang Yi would be afraid and refuse, and that he would waste a lot of time persuading.But I didn't expect that he would agree so happily. He immediately patted his shoulder and laughed and said: "Okay, you are a good man. Then figure out your training plan now. I will go to the palace to see your majesty later." "Beidi is rampant.Dongyu is eyeing him again, and we still have too few generals who can be used in a big way." Tang Yi knew that Di Cang always acted vigorously and resolutely, so today's training can only be put on hold and the three old men will probably be beaten if they wait for him to finish training.He could only take out a pen and paper and write down the training methods and guidelines one by one. It was not until dark that he finished writing the "Infantry Training Manual" and handed it to Di Cang.Di Cang got the manual and immediately took Qin Mu and Cheng Mao into the palace without stopping.Tang Yi, on the other hand, could only yawn and return home....Tang family.When Tang Yi returned to Tang's house, it was already evening.As soon as he entered the door, Tang Yi heard bursts of laughter.The voice is familiar.Tang Yi glanced at it lightly and couldn't help but sneered.Not far away, Tang Jing's family was sitting in the courtyard enjoying the cool air.Tang Hua is lying on the hammock reading leisurely while holding the scroll, elegant and lazy.Although Tang Hao and Lin Zhu were injured, they were feeding each other intimately.Tang Jing was sitting at the table, playing chess with a middle-aged man with a goatee.Yan Shuangyu stood behind Tang Jing, and the person advising the man with the goatee was a woman wearing a blue dress.The girl is seventeen or eighteen years old, very beautiful, with a clean and sweet smile, and she looks pure and charming.The man is Jiang Zheng, the censor of Yushitai, and the girl is Jiang Zheng's daughter, Jiang Yunna, the eldest daughter of the Jiang family.The picture is quite heartwarming, but unfortunately it is filled with the stench of conspiracy.Tang Yili ignored him and turned around to leave.At this time, Jiang Yunna also discovered him.She looked at Tang Yi with complicated emotions in her eyes. He was clearly an elegant and gentle young man back then, why has he turned into a vicious-hearted person now?What a disappointment.Fortunately, brother Tang Hua is such a gentle, free and charming person, and he keeps saying nice things to him. It's not worth it at all.Thinking of the agreement with Tang Hua, the emotion in Jiang Yunna's eyes quickly disappeared, and a blush appeared on her pretty face.Brother Tang Hua promised her that as long as she could stabilize Tang Yi and not let Tang Yi cause trouble in the marriage granted by His Majesty, he would marry her as his equal wife in the future.Not a concubine, but an equal wife to Kong Shilan!Moreover, brother Tang Hua said that he loved her, and that he and Kong Shilan were just acting on the occasion. In the future, she would still be the mistress of the Tang family."Brother Yi, are you back?" Thinking of this, Jiang Yunna smiled and ran towards Tang Yi, trying to grab Tang Yi's hand.It's just a matter of controlling Tang Yi, it's easy for her.In the past, as long as she waved, Tang Yi would run over like a dog.Now, would he miss this opportunity?Tang Hua put down the book, rested his head on one hand, and looked over jokingly.Huh, aren't you eloquent?I have worked so hard to set up a stage for you, you have to perform well!Tang Hao and Lin Zhu also put down their fruits and stared at Tang Yi with a sneer.They all knew that Tang Yi had unusual feelings for Jiang Yunna.Over the years, no matter how they bullied them, Tang Yi always accepted them.The only time he hit Tang Hua was when Tang Hua deliberately planned to marry Jiang Yunna, which completely angered him.The consequence of the action was that Jiang Yunna, who was deceived by Tang Hua and became lame, became even more disappointed with Tang Yi!Hehe, now that this guy is given a chance, Jiang Yunna waves, and this guy will probably run up to Jiang Yunna like a dog.Even Yan Shuangyu's eyes were full of mockery at this time.However, just when they thought Tang Yi would be so excited that he went crazy.Tang Yi subconsciously took a step back, preventing Jiang Yunna's hand from touching him."Ms. Jiang, please respect yourself." His tone was indifferent and distant, rejecting people thousands of miles away.Tang Yi looked at Jiang Yunna's frozen hand in mid-air and saw the stunned expressions of Yan Shuangyu, Tang Hua and others, and felt ridiculous
title_en: Chapter 79 I am Tang Yi, the principal of Dayan Military Academy!
